organism: # All values VERIFIED against the official EUCAST v14.0 PDF (Enterobacterales
# and Acinetobacter spp. sheets). CLSI was intentionally NOT included because
# CLSI M100 could not be accessed for verification; EUCAST is the sole primary
# standard. This is stated as a methodological choice/limitation in the report.
#  - EUCAST publishes "S<=" and "R>". The engine classifies R when mic>=R_min
#    so R_min is set to the smallest doubling-dilution strictly ABOVE the EUCAST
#  - no_breakpoint = EUCAST '-' or 'IE' (Insufficient Evidence): excluded from
#    the S/I/R panel for that organism.
#  - Panel chosen to cover the antimicrobial CATEGORIES needed for valid
